input.finding: Phren Hook's POST /v1/diff (and every POST target route) reads identity from a nested `data.target`; the body is `{ target, paths?, child? }`, never the target fields spread at the top level. A spread body makes `targetSchema.parse(data.target)` throw a ZodError that the server maps to HTTP 400 with a generic message. The `/v1/diff` `child` selector is a 32-hex parent-scoped id from `/v1/subagents`; when present the server ignores `paths` and returns `repositoryDiff(relation.cwd ?? trustedDirectory(pane), [], [])`, where `relation.cwd` is a fan-out manifest's `worktree`.
